data.title: Unit 8: Force, tools, and machines
Types of force
data.heading: Buoyancy
data.rubric: Drag the objects to the bowl to learn how objects float or sink in water.
data.text: Buoyancy is a force that works in water. It is an upward pressure exerted by water on the boat.
If the weight of the object is less than the total weight of the water it moves, then it will float.
If the weight of the object is more than the total weight of the water it moves, then it will sink.
